`$name = "compress.zlib://out.gz"; fopen($name, "w");` answered `false` where the
identical call with the literal compresses — in both directions. The wrapper was
reachable only from a compile-time literal, because that is what the split into
"wrapper" and "underlying path" needed, and a URL built with
`sys_get_temp_dir()` or read from a config file is ordinary PHP.

The opener is now parameterised over where the underlying path comes from: baked
